description: Executable OASNT-CAID Section 4.1 lifecycle and Section 6.4 dual-profile join vectors.

vectors.expect: the refused near-miss action does not consume the valid OASNT authority
a reserved attempt reconciled NOT_COMMITTED releases the authority for retry
a committed admission consumes the authority and a replay is refused
the OASNT CAID and EMILIA CAID for one action remain unequal profile-specific identifiers
independent profile derivations join only through the executor-owned material action
substituting an EMILIA identifier into the OASNT namespace fails closed
a changed identifier in either profile fails closed
identifiers derived for the original action cannot join a changed material action
